latestVersion.changelog:
Best Text To Video — Initial Release

- Instantly converts uploaded text (TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT) into AI-generated 1080p MP4 videos with voiceover and visuals.
- Seamless workflow: upload or describe your prompt and receive a ready-to-post video in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic handling of tokens, sessions, and cloud rendering—minimal setup required.
- Supports prompt-based editing, multi-format exports, file uploads up to 200MB, and project session management.
- Built for speed and ease-of-use, targeting marketers and content creators needing quick video generation from written content.
